Regenerate auth tokens on config install with fresh random tokens

New Library audio page with separate sound clip management
Context menus with Enable/Disable/Delete on library images and sounds
Multi-select event chips for game integrations
Generate new config button with fresh auth tokens
Auth tokens hidden from UI view
Lore pool auto-naming for imported sounds
Hover-lift animations on stat tiles and filter chips
